system.description:
Quite simply, Inconspicuous is the ability to go unnoticed in a crowd.

Obstacles: Inconspicuous is tested in versus tests against Observation. Inconspicuous tests are penalized under the following conditions: Garish or inappropriate dress, +1 Ob. Character is above/below his station, +1 Ob. Character is not from the region, +1 Ob. Character is of a different race than those he is trying to blend in with, +2 Ob.

FoRKs: Acting

Skill Type: Social. Tools: No.

Root: Will

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 278
